description: This file defines a base activity class for Android applications that handles initial setup like logging. It extends FragmentActivity and provides methods such as onCreate, onStart, and initializeLogging to facilitate common functions in activity subclasses.

classes.name: SampleActivityBase
classes.description: A base class for activities that provides common setup, particularly for logging purposes.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Called when the activity is starting; initializes the activity.

methods.name: onStart
methods.description: Called when the activity is becoming visible; calls initializeLogging.

methods.name: initializeLogging
methods.description: Sets up logging by wrapping the Android log and outputting a ready message.
